name.description: Admin page for a back-end add-on: users (client users and their device sessions), api-logs (server API logs), notifications (campaigns and send form), payments (transactions and wallets) or ai (usage statistics).

x-prompt.message: Which admin page do you want to add?

items.label: users - client users and their device sessions

path.description: Directory the page folder is created in. Defaults to `<sourceRoot>/app/modules/admin` (sourceRoot read from angular.json), or the `addon.path` value of fuse-schematics.json.

project.description: Project in angular.json to read sourceRoot from. Defaults to the first application project.

force.description: Overwrite page files that already exist. Without it, files that exist are left as they are.

skipRoute.description: Do not register the lazy route in <sourceRoot>/app/app.routes.ts

skipNav.description: Do not add a menu item to <sourceRoot>/app/core/navigation/navigation.ts

skipI18n.description: Do not add translation keys to <sourceRoot>/assets/i18n/*.json
